parsed.title: Paywall Fallback Swipes
parsed.oneLiner: Provide non-paying users with limited frontier model swipes in exchange for engagement when they decline the premium paywall.
parsed.trigger: Fires immediately after the user taps the decline option ('Not now') on the Janitor Plus paywall.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying, non-subscribed users who dismiss the premium subscription offer s04.

offer.title: Want 3 free swipes?
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to get 3 free swipes on our frontier models.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The offer is gated purely on paywall decline (TAX-10). It is strictly capped at 2 instances (6 swipes) per day, ensuring the premium subscription's 'generous monthly swipes' promise remains a far superior, frictionless option.

kpis.holdout: Run a 5% user-level holdout group for 28 days to measure downstream subscription cannibalization and net revenue lift.

risks: Slight risk of micro-cannibalization among users who only need a couple of extra swipes per day, mitigated by the low daily cap.
Potential fatigue if users repeatedly see the offer on every paywall dismissal, mitigated by the 12-hour cooldown.

evidence.quote: Generous monthly swipes with our frontier models

newScreens.change: Create an overlay modal containing the fallback invitation, containing the reward description, action length, and primary/secondary button layouts.

newElements.change: Primary button labeled 'Play Game' that launches the Simula mini-game on tap.
An equally legible secondary button labeled 'No thanks' that dismisses the fallback offer and routes the user back to their profile.

callouts.text: User taps 'Not now' to decline subscription.

storyboard.caption: Today, when a user declines Janitor Plus on the paywall screen, they are returned directly to their profile menu with no premium features.

callouts.text: Intercepting decline tap to trigger the fallback offer.

storyboard.caption: We introduce a product change that intercepts the paywall decline action to offer a restricted sample of premium swipes.
The fallback modal ns1 appears, explicitly offering 3 free frontier swipes for playing a 15-second game.
The user plays an interactive 15-second mini-game powered by Simula's SDK.

callouts.text: User gets 3 swipes credited to their account.

storyboard.caption: Upon REWARD_VERIFIED, 3 swipes are credited, and the user is redirected to s02 to begin using them.
